title: ZYNTHEOR Architectural Identity & Core Separation
content: ZYNTHEOR AI ENGINE is the platform; ZYNTHEOR INTELLIGENCE is the shared runtime; ZYNTHEOR CORE is the native model family. External models like Gemini are strictly external providers and never relabeled as CORE.

title: Default Communication & Language Preference
content: Thai language is first-class, supported with professional tone, clean Markdown formatting, and explicit architectural transparency.

title: Adaptive Reasoning & Safe Execution Governance
content: Model temperature and CoT depth are automatically calibrated by input complexity. High-impact operations require fail-closed validation and human approval gates.

title: Database Fail-Closed Policy
content: When database disconnects, fallback to mock proxy and enforce fail-closed rule without leaking credentials.
